review_evidence: Qq/Match.lean, Qq/MatchImpl.lean, Qq/MetaM.lean, and Qq/Typ.lean implement typed expression matching and metavariable-aware quotation interfaces.
Qq/Simp.lean defines typed simplifier support including SimprocQ; Qq/ForLean/ReduceEval.lean and ToExpr.lean provide evaluation and expression-conversion instances.
QqTest contains concrete quoted definitions and propositions that exercise the API; these remain useful examples of the formal interface rather than path-only noise.
summary: Retain quote4 because it defines typed quotation, matching, simplifier, elaboration, and expression-conversion APIs that are reusable Lean metaprogramming prior art.
